answer: Ask the panel what it trusts: the whisper it can verify, the reef it can count, the cedar it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. One agent spends 19 minutes and is done; the farm spends 6992 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Tin beater tinplate warrant soldered into the painting shed, the mark is each tinplate is a season of logged solderings plus a signed tin record, and the panel accepts nothing else.
